title: Whitley Strieber's abduction books and films
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Whitley Strieber's abduction books and films, about 1980s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's this guy who made these movies and books about being abducted by aliens.

plain: The podcast host Joe Rogan, talking with fellow host Jesse Michels, brings up Whitley Strieber, a writer who, as Rogan puts it, made movies and books in the 1980s about being abducted by aliens. Rogan mentions him as a well-known person who says this happened to him.
